scenes.title: 19/3/25, élection [de la] reine des reines, Mlles Delapierre, Camier, Fraigneux, Henry, Laurent [de d. à g.]
scenes.description: A press photograph taken by Agence Rol on March 19, 1925, showing the election of the "queen of queens" and depicting Mlles Delapierre, Camier, Fraigneux, Henry, and Laurent from right to left. It belongs to the Bibliothèque nationale de France, département Estampes et photographie, and is in the public domain.
scenes.explanation: Smartwatches with lit digital displays did not exist in 1925, as the first modern smartwatch was released in 2015.

scenes.title: [10-3-12, Juvisy, cross country international de l'Auto] Rivez, J. Kern, Kolehmanen, Bouchard, Holmer [coureurs]
scenes.description: A press photograph by Agence Rol, dated 10 March 1912, shows the runners Rivez, J. Kern, Kolehmanen, Bouchard and Holmer at the international cross-country race of L'Auto at Juvisy. The black-and-white glass negative, held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France, measures 13 x 18 cm.
scenes.anomaly: modern running shoe with thick foam midsole
scenes.explanation: Cushioned foam-soled running shoes did not exist in 1912; the runners' footwear here is thin leather with spikes.

scenes.title: S. T. [Louvre. Pavillons Turgot et Richelieu] / Baldus, Edouard
scenes.description: A photograph by Edouard Baldus from 1857 shows the Pavillons Turgot et Richelieu of the Louvre. The record identifies it as an architectural photograph held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France and the Ecole nationale des ponts et chaussées.
scenes.explanation: CCTV security cameras did not exist in 1857; they were developed in the mid-20th century.

scenes.title: miss Spooner, aviatrice
scenes.description: A press photograph from September 1929 by Agence Meurisse shows miss Spooner, an aviatrice, with biplanes. It is held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France, département Estampes et photographie.
scenes.explanation: The plastic zip tie was patented in 1958, so it did not exist when this photograph was taken in 1929.

scenes.title: Albanie, 2-4-11 [rassemblement d'hommes devant une maison]
scenes.description: A press photograph by Agence Rol, dated 2 April 1911, showing a gathering of men in front of a house in Albanie. The record identifies the subjects as rioters in Albanie and notes the image is held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France.
scenes.explanation: Telescoping aluminum selfie sticks did not exist in 1911; they became common consumer products only in the 1980s and later.
